production_publicitaire.title: ADVERTISING CONTENT THAT CAPTURES ATTENTION
production_publicitaire.description: At Malinki, we design and produce advertising content that captures attention in the first few seconds. Whether it's for a web campaign, television, or social media, we focus on clear ideas, strong visuals, and agile execution.
production_publicitaire.testimonial_text: Malinki was able to deliver an advertising campaign in record time, without sacrificing quality.
production_publicitaire.headline_line2: AN AD THAT PACKS A PUNCH
production_publicitaire.paragraph1: We work hand in hand with your team to ensure that each piece of content serves a specific purpose: to sell, raise awareness, launch, or mobilize.
production_publicitaire.paragraph2: Our approach is simple: we ask the right questions, propose solid ideas, and deliver quickly, without compromising on quality.
production_publicitaire.prods_text_1: Short formats designed for web and social media, optimized to capture attention and generate action.
production_publicitaire.prods_text_2: 6, 15, or 30-second content, effective narration and compliance with broadcasting standards, for high-reach campaigns.
production_publicitaire.prods_text_3: Strong visuals consistent with your advertising videos, captured in studio or on location, to feed all your channels.
production_publicitaire.feature_image_alt: Two men watching TV on a couch
production_publicitaire.bts_image_4_alt: Behind the scenes: director at work

contenu_de_marque.title: REAL CONTENT THAT TELLS, UNITES AND RESONATES
contenu_de_marque.description_1: Every brand has a unique identity. Our role is to make it shine with your clients, your employees, and the talent you want to attract.
contenu_de_marque.description_2: We create authentic content, based on real listening, an understanding of your challenges, and an ability to translate your values into stories that make an impact.
contenu_de_marque.bts_description: We don't make generic content. We dig into your brand DNA to create pieces that have meaning, that spark emotion, and build a real connection with your audience. At Malinki, every image carries intention.
contenu_de_marque.testimonial_text: Professional, efficient, and attentive from start to finish. The shoot went smoothly, structured, and well organized.
contenu_de_marque.testimonial_text_2: [...] and on top of being talented, they are kind, generous, and pleasant to work with. A valuable collaboration we recommend without hesitation!
contenu_de_marque.prods_text_1: We highlight the people behind your company: founders, employees, clients, to create an authentic connection with your audience.
contenu_de_marque.prods_text_2: Strong visuals consistent with your advertising videos, captured in studio or on location, to feed all your channels.
contenu_de_marque.prods_text_3: We build consistent narrative formats, designed to build audience loyalty over the long term.
contenu_de_marque.prods_text_4: Strong visuals consistent with your advertising videos, captured in studio or on location, to feed all your channels.
contenu_de_marque.contact_cta_text: Your brand has a story. We help you tell it.

contenu_vertical.title: SHORT-FORM CONTENT DESIGNED FOR THE LONG TERM
contenu_vertical.description: Each platform has its own codes: format, tone, rhythm, visuals... Everything matters. Adapting your message is essential to reach the right people, in the right place, in the right way.
contenu_vertical.testimonial_text: We trust Malinki as a partner because they are agile and flexible. They always deliver quality content, often within tight deadlines.
contenu_vertical.tiktoks_description: On TikTok and Reels, everything happens in the first few seconds. You have to get straight to the point, grab attention, but above all, stay authentic. We create vertical content that's punchy and on-trend, without ever sacrificing your brand voice. Whether it's funny, educational, or moving, we know how to get your message across in a format that's shareable and memorable.
